notes: 9.7 accepted only the `information` spelling and had no `group` list keyword; 9.8.54 accepts `info`, `information` (same table) and `group`.
`group` the list keyword prints the Slot:Groupname table; the sibling command 'massflow marker group' is what assigns groups.
MassFlow adds marker-specific range elements: `range marker-type <i>` (-2 to 3) and the flag `range active`.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: List extra-variable information from slot i (1 to 128).

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: List marker group names (ID and Slot:Groupname table).

keywords.name: info
keywords.description: List the per-object information table. The 9.8 manual's documented spelling; `information` is also accepted.

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on MassFlow 9.8.54 (GUI bridge) (state grade): 'massflow marker list info|information|group' each printed its own table header (Marker information / Marker Groups) on an empty model; bogus tokens are reported as unused AFTER the bare list has run.
